macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: 0.12 estimated ratio of ivory-colored tipping relative to the total vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinct white facial chevron, sub-orbital markings, and high-contrast white patches on the lower limbs and fetlocks.
